source_limits: The Tribe-authored September 2020 plan recounts a 1908 Secretary Order and termination in 1958. This is explicitly an attributed historical account, not a new legal finding, a creation date for the people, or an independently reviewed order or statute. Its 1985 reestablishment account is not used to settle the precise legal recognition or restoration chronology.

The September 2020 plan identifies a planning priority before major development. A plan is not proof that wetland assessment, restoration, development or regulatory approval was completed. The EPA path and filename mention 2021, but rendered cover, title and page footers say 2020; the source event year is 2020.

The November 5, 2026 announcement supports a reported cohort and its stated support areas. It does not independently establish hiring records, measured emissions reduction, food quantities recovered, community outcomes, cultural-use permission, or current volunteer eligibility and availability.

The November 23, 2026 announcement reports a contribution supporting pavilion completion. The transfer, receipt of funds, final building completion, opening, accessibility and public-use schedule have not been independently verified. Its headline total and arithmetic are not reproduced.

The undated About page gives a 2.85-acre figure and a1985 recognition account. These are excluded from public facts pending primary legal chronology and reconciliation of acreage units and dates with the 2020 plan. No current population, enrollment requirement, officeholder, legal boundary or acreage is inferred.

The scanned plan was visually read at PDF pages1-4; text extraction returned blank pages. Relevant source text was transcribed from rendered page3, with its full page context reviewed. No map, logo, personal signature, photograph or full source page is republished.

The climate article includes a named partnership with a separate Tuolumne Band government. This does not merge governments or establish cultural permission. No cultural fire instructions or restricted knowledge are reproduced.
